terms.comment: Traupman 324 gives juvenēscō, but that means “reach youth, grow young again” (Hor., Ov.), not a child’s growing up.

phrases.latin: Cum magnus eris, ipse birotā vehēris.
phrases.english: When you’re big, you’ll ride a bike yourself.

sources: Lewis & Short: adolesco
